items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And Willie wanted me back in the band. Willie and I, I was just like one of his boys.

ctx.x: A big attraction, and they had a big display where the stars were falling, and one thing and another. It was a beautiful thing to see. And they really made a big name then. So consequently, that helped Willie to get in the Cotton Club with the band quicker than if he had just been out there on his own -- one of them things.

So Mills put him in, and put Cab out on the road, and consequently, he started to change his men in the band. And Willie wanted me back in the band. Willie and I, I was just like one of his boys. It didn't make sense for me to be walking the street, and he had a job, and he could use me. So he put me back in his band. That was all right with me.
